task.title: Add a --dry-run flag to the sync command
task.body:
Add a --dry-run flag to the sync command

The sync command always writes. Add a flag that reports what it would do.

- [ ] Add `--dry-run` to `sync` in src/cli.rs
- [ ] Print each file that would change, one per line
- [ ] Exit 0 without writing anything
- [ ] Add a test in tests/sync.rs

The flag parser lives in src/args.rs.
